scope: Actual approved UI implementation, real Roadster guest preview, real Rapier local test drive and software-WebGL terrain. Synthetic snapshots are explicitly used only for lobby/results UI coverage. Not photorealism or physical-device FPS certification.
checks: Actual guest screen updates driver name and full Roadster paint
Settings save steering and reduced-motion preferences
Local test drive loads the actual new terrain without signalling
Desktop race hides touch pedals and keeps a working minimap
In-session graphics cannot silently disconnect or change the race
Real online menu releases controls but does not pause host rules
Map contains eight checkpoints and four nitro markers
Portrait touch race keeps wheel/pedals accessible
Opened chat accepts typing without driving
Local chat is plain text in the implemented chat panel
Implemented results list has racer names and times
